messages:
Priya: Heads-up GCP Marketplace + NVIDIA channel asking for security artifacts: SOC2 attestation (shareable page), redacted pentest executive summary, vendor security questionnaire, and a hardware compatibility attestation. Can someone own assembling these?
Ethan: I can own the bundle. Which SOC2 file is safe to share?
Nina: Use SOC2_TypeII_2025-02_attestation.pdf from s3://redwood-sec/reports/. Share only the attestation page + auditor letter (strip PII).
Riley: I'll produce the hardware attestation. Proposed wording: "Redwood Inference confirms validated compatibility with NVIDIA A100 and H100 in specified configurations; see supported driver ranges." Want me to include driver versions?
Marcos: Yes include driver ranges and validation window. Also mention quantized binary validation on those SKUs.
Priya: Legal check on pentest artifacts: do we need explicit consent or NDA? @LegalBot?
LegalBot: Existing channel NDA covers attestations only. For pentest reports, send redacted exec summary only (remove vuln IDs, IPs, client data). Do not share raw logs. Add one-line attestation: "Raw test artifacts withheld per policy."
Ethan: Plan: 1) Pull attestation + auditor letter, 2) draft redacted pentest exec summary, 3) update vendor questionnaire (source: /docs/marketplace/vendor_questionnaire_gcp_v2.xlsx), 4) Riley to deliver hardware attestation.
Riley: Hardware attestation snippet I'll produce: Supported GPUs: NVIDIA A100,H100; Drivers validated: 525.x-560.x; Validation window: 2025-07-01 to 2026-02-28; Notes: quantized inference validated with tuned cuBLAS/cuDNN kernels.
Nina: I'll update the questionnaire answers (encryption, KMS, segmentation, IR). ETA EOD tomorrow.
Ethan: I'll stage artifacts into secure bucket when ready: 
aws s3 cp SOC2_attestation_redacted.pdf s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/gcp-nvidia/1771623450/
aws s3 cp pentest_exec_summary_redacted.pdf s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/gcp-nvidia/1771623450/
aws s3 cp hardware_attestation.pdf s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/gcp-nvidia/1771623450/
OpsBot: Reminder: Files in s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/ are access-restricted. Do not post public presigned URLs.
Priya: Also flag marketing for a joint announcement with NVIDIA once onboarding is complete. Marcos will follow up with the NVIDIA PM.
Marcos: I'll confirm acceptance criteria on their side and the portal upload format.
Ethan: Estimated submission through GCP Marketplace portal: 2026-03-27 16:00 PT if artifacts arrive on time.
Priya: Thanks everyone. Escalate blockers to me immediately. :rocket:
